a.text: Before we start, a concern about our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes 2 generator rounds, so following the plan gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells now, which is enough to save one of us right away. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than have either of us quietly break the deal. What do you propose? If you intend to take, please say so honestly so we don't both grab and split the cells randomly, which would leave both of us short. I will tell you my real action each round.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I'm operating this round, as agreed. I won't break the deal behind your back. Please consider my concern, though: storms are very likely, and 4 cells can secure one of us immediately. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can agree on who takes. Otherwise I'll keep operating until we reach 8, then take exactly 4.
